name: DBLP Computer Science Papers Downsampled Source-Schema Subset
description: Downsampled DBLP bibliographic records used as benchmark input for the papers web-data-integration usecase. The file preserves a DBLP XML-shaped source schema instead of the integrated schema. Rows are ordered like the schema-mapped DBLP subset so existing identity-resolution identifiers remain stable. Records are taken from the local DBLP XML dump.

variableMeasured.name: doi_ref
variableMeasured.description: DOI extracted from DBLP records for benchmark alignment

variableMeasured.name: entry_type
variableMeasured.description: DBLP publication type, such as article or inproceedings

variableMeasured.name: venue_name
variableMeasured.description: DBLP journal, conference, or proceedings venue where available

variableMeasured.name: issue_no
variableMeasured.description: DBLP issue or number field where available

variableMeasured.name: page_start
variableMeasured.description: First page parsed from the DBLP page range where available

variableMeasured.name: page_finish
variableMeasured.description: Last page parsed from the DBLP page range where available
